tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Project Manager | SAP Commerce Cloud & Shopify Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven track record designing data pipelines, leading techno-functional analysis, writing user stories and functional specs, and driving CI/CD deployments on cloud environments. Skilled in stakeholder coordination, agile project delivery and AI-assisted development, ready to steer full-cycle commerce projects.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Project Manager*in Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited by FOODBOOM’s vision of turning community-driven food content into a thriving e-commerce business. With over five years building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical and commercial expertise to launch and grow digital storefronts.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, handling product catalogs, pricing and order management, directly aligning with the need to build a robust commerce backbone.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Implemented PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines and ERP integrations using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring synchronized product data—experience directly transferable to Shopify-ERP sync.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Acted as liaison between business stakeholders and development teams, writing user stories, functional specs and guiding agile delivery, matching the project-management and cross-functional coordination required.

bullets.label: AI-Assisted Delivery
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, code generation and documentation, boosting efficiency—aligning with FOODBOOM’s openness to AI-driven processes.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: FOODBOOM’s unique blend of food-content publishing and e-commerce resonates with my passion for building community-driven digital experiences. I admire how you translate editorial reach into a tangible product offering and see a clear opportunity to apply my SAP Commerce expertise to shape a scalable, data-rich Shopify store that deepens customer engagement and drives sustainable revenue growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help FOODBOOM turn its vibrant food community into a thriving e-commerce platform, leveraging my SAP Commerce and integration experience to build and optimise the new Shopify store.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years of e-commerce delivery. I’m excited about FOODBOOM’s Project Manager role and would love to discuss how I can help launch and scale your Shopify store. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Project Manager*in Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Project Manager*in Commerce role at FOODBOOM. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am ready to lead your commerce build-out and integrate Shopify with existing systems. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with your vision.
